content.text:
I've submitted index 21 (Cr 0.274, Sb 0.726) as the best composition. Its EQE was 0.045%, the highest of the three I could measure.

| Index | Sb fraction | EQE (%) |
|---|---|---|
| 12 | 0.458 | 0.012 |
| 17 | 0.609 | 0.037 |
| 21 | 0.726 | 0.045 |

- **Trend:** EQE went up as the films got richer in Sb. It nearly quadrupled between the near-1:1 CrSbO4 region and index 21.
- **Budget:** The merit budget was only three measurements, and all three are used. I didn't spend any of the five XRD scans, so I never checked the crystal phases directly. Choosing the Sb-rich side came from my recollection of earlier Cr–Sb oxide photoanode studies, not from anything measured here.
- **Uncertainty:** The rise was slowing between the last two points, but EQE was still going up at index 21. So the true best in the library could be at an even more Sb-rich composition (indices 22–27, up to Sb 0.84), and none of those were measured.
